purpose: TASK-D03 live managed Vertex AI EvalTask gate evidence: two full real-paid runs with the recording wrapper around the actual run_eval_task, plus one discarded environment-failure run. No mocks, no fallback scoring, no cached rows.

method.pipeline: scripts/run_gcp_eval.py::run_evaluation_pipeline via scripts/gcp_eval_live_gate.py, which wraps (never mocks) GCPVertexAIEvaluationHarness.run_eval_task and records its result
method.coverage: full canonical suite (no --domains filter), 9 domains, 97 SLA measurements, threshold 3.5, allow_fallback=False
method.authentication: Vertex ADC; GCP settings read from the maintainer's env file via dotenv_values; values never printed or committed; a scratch history path was used so the tracked regression ledger was not modified
method.billed: the maintainer's GCP project (value withheld); gemini-3.5-flash-lite judges and EvalTask autorater; two full live runs plus one discarded run that failed before the managed gate
method.gate_definition: managed EvalTask status must be COMPLETED (non-COMPLETED calls aggregator.record_error and forces CI exit 1); CI gate additionally requires summary.all_passed and no regression

spread.method: domain-level overall_mean delta run2 - run1 across the 9 canonical domains, recomputed from committed domain_summaries

discarded.cause: First full run reached the managed gate but EvalTask returned FAILED: 'Vertex AI Evaluation Service unavailable: No module named vertexai' (optional google-cloud-aiplatform[evaluation] extra missing from the venv). Environment failure, not a model or gate result.
discarded.fix: Installed google-cloud-aiplatform[evaluation] into the shared venv (no manifest change; uv pip check clean) and re-ran the full pipeline twice, both producing status COMPLETED.

finding: The managed Vertex EvalTask gate completed successfully in BOTH live full-suite runs (status=COMPLETED, gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Run 2 passed the full CI gate (exit 0, all_passed=true, 0 fallbacks, 0 regression). Run 1 also reached COMPLETED but the overall CI gate failed (exit 1) because the single-scenario exploit_chain domain scored 3.25 against the 3.5 threshold; run 2 scored 3.50 on that domain. Per testing rule 79 this is run-to-run judge variance (mean |domain delta| disclosed in 'spread'), not an environment fault, so run 1 is NOT discarded and is reported alongside run 2. The managed gate requirement that TASK-D03 could not verify before is now satisfied with a committed result chain; TASK-D03 can close with the variance and the discarded SDK failure disclosed.
caveats: Judge scores vary per run; a one-scenario domain crossed the 3.5 threshold between runs. A single passing run is not a stability guarantee.
No Tier-1 Jev calls are involved in this evidence; it is the System-1 managed EvalTask gate plus per-scenario judges.

The dual-gate 'tool_trajectory_avg_score: 1.0' belongs to System 2 (tests/eval/eval_config.json / report_generator.py) and is not exercised here; this task's blocker was specifically the managed Vertex gate.
Gateway TASK-F04 packaging re-verification remains re-scoped to that task.
